name: LAZARUS PHARMACEUTICALS SurgeonSight MS-4 Ocular
product_name: Lazarus Pharmaceuticals SurgeonSight MS-4 Precision Ocular
description:
The SurgeonSight MS-4 is a medical-grade bilateral ocular implant engineered for precision surgical and diagnostic work, featuring a variable zoom array from 0.8x wide-field to 120x cellular-level magnification with image stabilization rated to 0.003mm tremor correction. Its onboard spectrographic tissue-analysis overlay identifies vascular structures, nerve clusters, and tissue health gradients in real time, color-coded against a surgically neutral HUD that doesn't interfere with ambient depth perception. Vein-mapping and subsurface anatomy rendering are processed via Lazarus' proprietary BioLens AI, trained on 40 million anonymized surgical cases.

The MS-4 is the dominant surgical ocular in Meridian 88's licensed medical sector, standard equipment for Tier 3-5 hospital staff and private clinic surgeons. It has secondary adoption among tattoo artists, watchmakers, and forensic technicians who benefit from its magnification without needing full surgical-grade tissue analysis. Lazarus offers a subsidized licensing program for public hospital surgeons, making it one of the few high-performance medical cyberware products accessible below Tier 4.
installation_requirements: Bilateral ocular socket surgery; Lazarus-certified surgical installation mandatory; medical license registration required for tissue-analysis activation
rejection_risk: Minimal — Lazarus biocompatible hydrogel housing and anti-rejection coating; rejection rate under 2% in clinical trials
maintenance: Bi-annual BioLens AI recalibration at Lazarus clinic; lens array cleaning monthly; firmware update quarterly

cultural_context: Among Meridian 88's surgical community, the SurgeonSight MS-4 is the professional baseline — showing up to an operating theater with lesser optics is a credibility statement. The Lazarus subsidy program is quietly political, ensuring the megacity's public hospital system stays dependent on Lazarus infrastructure.

story_hooks: A surgeon's BioLens AI is flagging every patient with the same anomaly — a subcutaneous marker that shouldn't exist, hidden in hundreds of people across the megacity
The Lazarus subsidy program comes with a hidden clause: all tissue-analysis data feeds anonymously to a Lazarus research server — someone wants that database destroyed or stolen
